question: If three cubes whose edges measure 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm respectively, are melted to form a single cube, then find the edge of the new cube.
solution:
**Given:**

Three cubes whose edges measure 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm respectively, are melted to form a single cube

**Formula used:**

Volume of cube = a3 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/896cc7ce40ae929909e0f0dc5641255c826a38726977bb4664b8e0136de66dea.png] 

Calculation:

Sum of volume of three cubes whose edges measure 3 cm, 4 cm and 5 cm = Volume of new cube

⇒ 3³ + 4³ + 5³ = a³

⇒ 27 + 64 + 125 = a³

⇒ a³ = 216

⇒ a = 6 cm
